equal_vertex_comparator: near-uniform horizontal rows; floor/ceil N/rows vertices per row; deterministic strip triangulation; corners included
interpolator: piecewise linear barycentric on provided triangle connectivity
primary_metric: held-out RMSE over the frozen uniformly sampled positions
sample_generator: Python random.Random(20261118); independent uniform x,y from random()
scope: public synthetic known analytic field; held-out locations only, not blind or general meshing accuracy
selection_policy: retain first valid native mesh; no held-out point/error tuning; report loss/null result
